mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_security_log ( tenant_id, actor_id, event_type, risk_level, subject_type, subject_id, subject_ref, result_status, detail_json, trace_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{eventType}, #{riskLevel}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectRef}, #{resultStatus}, CAST(#{detailJson} AS jsonb), #{traceId}, #{createdAt} )
